Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued, maintenance staff must carry the suitable ID safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
Wear your safety and healthy equipment as safety helmet, shoes, breathing mask, ... etc.
Surge Arrester out of service.
A work permit must be issued, maintenance staff must carry the suitable ID safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
Wear your safety and healthy equipment as safety helmet, shoes, breathing mask, ... etc.
There is danger of falling off the top of the arrester when cleaning 
 insulators or checking connections wear your safety belt.
Isolation and proper earthing is required
Tools and Equipment
Rags, 
 Fiberglass ladder.
Voltage indicator, thermovision gun.
Tool set for tightness, cleaning tools as cloth .... etc
Check that there is no voltage, 
 clean 
 all porcelain
 insulators
 surfaces
 of surge arrestor.
Check porcelain for cracks and chipped skirts.
Check for loose caps and tighten if necessary.
If fitted, read and record discharge counter reading.
Put the surge 
 arrester into service and carry out 
 thermo 
 vision test for hotspot for its connection with network.
